paper_title: MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio,   Music, and Their Mix
caption: : Compare with noise input on MMAR
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages obtained across four different experimental conditions: Owen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, Qwen-2.5-Omni, and Noise, when processing input with added noise. The horizontal axis displays the names of the experimental conditions, listed alphabetically. The vertical axis represents accuracy percentages, ranging from 0% to 60%, and marked with linear scale increments. The value axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and consists of tick intervals of 10%, with values ranging from 28% to 56%. There are four bars representing each experimental condition, colored blue for Owen2-Audio-Instruct, purple for Audio-Reasoner, pink for Qwen-2.5-Omni, and grey for Noise. The bar representing Owen2-Audio-Instruct reaches approximately 56%, the bar for Audio-Reasoner reaches approximately 34%, the bar for Qwen-2.5-Omni reaches approximately 38%, and the bar for Noise reaches approximately 30%. All bars are presented with equal height and are not sorted or visually emphasized.
